visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen collage shows several women in various kitchen settings preparing ingredients. The main character, a woman with blonde-highlighted hair in a white top, stands in a modern, dark-toned kitchen, smiling and gesturing as she speaks to the camera. (2) The camera pans through a sleek apartment interior called 'MELT TAIPEI,' showing a living room with a large projector screen displaying a music video, a minimalist bedroom with neutral linens, and a clean white bathroom with marble walls. (3) A woman with long blonde hair (Cook 1) is shown in the kitchen pouring a clear broth into bowls containing chicken and scallions. She wears a white long-sleeved shirt and moves with a professional demeanor. (4) Transition to a woman in a pink beanie and a blue apron (Cook 2) wrapping slices of raw meat around large onion rings on a wooden cutting board. She is seen frying them in a silver pan until they are browned and caramelized. (5) A woman in a shiny silver button-down shirt (Cook 3) uses a green hand-held grater to shred zucchini into a large white bowl. She then pours an egg mixture into a pan to create a thick, golden-brown omelet. (6) A woman in a black apron (Cook 4) prepares small individual metal ramekins filled with a mixture of ground meat and eggs. She is later seen carrying a tray of the finished, baked products which look like savory meat tarts. (7) The main creator (Cook 5) is seen finely dicing pink shrimp on a wooden board. She then pours a large amount of bright orange fish roe from a metal container into a pan of fried rice, mixing it vigorously. (8) A group of five women sit on a dark grey sofa, laughing and holding small bowls of food. The screen displays a poll with the names of the five dishes, encouraging viewers to vote as they wave at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop BGM with a steady 4-on-the-floor beat begins. A clear female voice-over introduces the challenge with high pitch and enthusiastic prosody. (2) Sounds of sliding drawers and light metallic clinking (kitchen utensils) are heard as the location is described. The BGM maintains a bright, upbeat texture. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect transitions the focus to the first cook. Sounds of a liquid being poured and faint chopping are audible under the narration. (4) Rapid percussive sizzling sounds occur as the second cook fries the meat donuts. Several female voices laugh and offer excited commentary with high emotional arousal. (5) A rhythmic scratching/scraping sound of a vegetable grater is prominent. A cartoon-style 'pop' SFX accompanies a variety caption. (6) More sizzle and the sound of a lid being lifted from a pan. The narrator's speech rate increases while describing the difficulty of the dishes. (7) Loud collective cheering and high-pitched 'wow' exclamations occur during the roe-pouring scene. The sound of mixing a heavy grain-like substance is audible. (8) Group laughter and overlapping chatter dominate as the music swells for the conclusion. A final synthesized 'sparkle' SFX plays during the voting prompt.
